newsitem.title: DUBAI: At least three killed in heavy Saudi rainfall.
newsitem.headline: At least three killed in heavy Saudi rainfall.

text.p: Freak rain storms and gale force winds killed at least three people and injured four others over the weekend in Saudi Arabia, Saudi newspapers said on Sunday.
Floods swept a couple to their deaths after their car got trapped in high waters and a teacher died after lightning struck his tent in a Red Sea coastal area.
Four men were taken to hospital after a bridge collapsed in the Leith region, 200 km (125 miles) south of Jeddah.
Heavy rainfall cut off many villages and swept away several homes and cars in the nearby valley, scene of persistent rain-linked disasters.
Saudis prayed for rain across the parched kingdom earlier this month in response to an appeal by King Fahd.
